references.text: Psalm 119:22 describes how evil can increase and lead to worse consequences, similar to how evil spirits multiply and worsen the condition of a person in Matthew 12:45.
In John 5:14, Jesus warns a healed man not to sin again so that nothing worse may happen to him, reflecting the warning about worse consequences from returning to sin in Matthew 12:45.
In Exodus 8:15, we see how Pharaoh's heart was hardened after the plague was lifted, which can be compared to how the person in Matthew 12:45 ends up in a worse condition after being 'cleansed'.
Hebrews 6:4-6 discusses the impossibility of renewing to repentance those who have once fallen away after tasting the heavenly gift, similar to the worsened condition described in Matthew 12:45.
Ezekiel 23:22 speaks about returning to former sins and how this leads to greater destruction, paralleling the concept in Matthew 12:45 of ending up in a worse state.
